Elon Musk's 14 Children: All About the Tesla CEO's Sons and Daughters ​

Visit a space made especially for Moms, by Parents. (Paid Partnership)

Elon Musk and Shivon Zilis with their twins Strider and Azure ; Elon Musk with son X. Credit :

Shivon Zilis/ X ; Elon Musk/ X

Elon Musk has welcomed 14 children over 20 years.

The Tesla founder first became a father in 2002 when his ex-wife, Canadian author Justine Wilson, welcomed their son Nevada Alexander, who tragically died at 10 weeks old. The two went on to have five more children: twins Vivian and Griffin and triplets Kai, Saxon and Damian.

After divorcing Wilson in 2008 following seven years of marriage, Musk married and divorced actress Talulah Riley twice, though they never had children together. In 2020, two years after Musk and singer Grimes were first linked, the two announced they welcomed their first child, X Æ A-12, together.

The former couple share two more children, a girl, Exa Dark Sideræl, and a boy, Techno Mechanicus. A few weeks prior to the arrival of their second child, the tech CEO also secretly fathered twins, Strider and Azure, with Shivon Zilis, an executive at one of his companies, Neuralink, in November 2021, according to court documents published by Insider.

Every Woman Elon Musk Has Children With — and What They’ve Said About Their Blended Family

The pair then welcomed daughter Arcadia in February 2024. Later that year, a source told PEOPLE that Musk and Grimes were looking for a home in Bel Air where they could live with all of his children and their mothers.

In February 2025, author Ashley St. Clair revealed that she and Musk had welcomed a child, whose name was later revealed to be Romulus. Zilis then announced that she and Musk had secretly welcomed baby No. 4, son Seldon Lycurgus, though it's unclear when.

Another update came in May, when St. Clair told The New York Times that Musk told her that he had also fathered a child with a Japanese pop star, though this claim has not been confirmed.

Here's everything to know about Elon Musk's 14 children: Nevada, Vivian, Griffin, Kai, Saxon, Damian, X Æ A-12, Exa, Strider, Azure, Techno, Arcadia, Seldon Lycurgus and Romulus.

## Nevada Alexander

Musk welcomed his son, Nevada Alexander, with his first wife, Justine Wilson in 2002. Sadly, at 10 weeks old, he passed away from sudden infant death syndrome (SIDS).

"Nevada went down for a nap, placed on his back as always, and stopped breathing," Wilson wrote in a 2010 essay for Marie Claire. "By the time the paramedics resuscitated him, he had been deprived of oxygen for so long that he was brain-dead."

She continued, "He spent three days on life support in a hospital in Orange County before we made the decision to take him off it. I held him in my arms when he died."

## Vivian Jenna Wilson and Griffin

Elon Musk's daughter Vivian Jenna Wilson poses for a photo in November 2024.

Vivian Jenna Wilson/ Instagram

In her Marie Claire essay, Wilson detailed the couple's journey to expand their family further.

"I buried my feelings ... coping with Nevada's death by making my first visit to an IVF clinic less than two months later. Elon and I planned to get pregnant again as swiftly as possible. Within the next five years, I gave birth to twins, then triplets," she wrote.

In April 2022, one of Musk's twins petitioned the court to legally change her name to Vivian Jenna Wilson (the maiden name of her mother, Justine Wilson) and to recognize her gender as female. In court documents obtained by PEOPLE, Vivian explained that she no longer wished "to be related to my biological father in any way, shape or form."

The petition was eventually granted in June of that same year.

While speaking to the Financial Times in October 2022, Musk said he believes Vivian doesn't want to be associated with him because of the supposed takeover of elite schools and universities by neo-Marxists.

"It's full-on communism . . . and a general sentiment that if you're rich, you're evil," said the Tesla CEO. "It [the relationship] may change, but I have very good relationships with all the others [children]. Can't win them all."

In July 2024, after Musk said he was "tricked" into allowing Vivian to undergo gender-affirming medical treatments and stated that his "son is dead," Vivian responded on Threads.

"This entire thing is completely made up and there’s a reason for this. He doesn’t know what I was like as a child because he quite simply wasn’t there, and in the little time that he was I was relentlessly harassed for my femininity and queerness," she wrote.

During an interview with NBC News, Vivian explained her decision to speak out.

"I think he was under the assumption that I wasn’t going to say anything and I would just let this go unchallenged," she said. "Which I’m not going to do, because if you’re going to lie about me, like, blatantly to an audience of millions, I’m not just gonna let that slide. ... He was there, I want to say, maybe 10% of the time. That's generous. He had half custody, and he fully was not there."

Grimes, the mother of three of Musk's children, posted on X in support of Vivian, writing, "I love and am forever endlessly proud of Vivian."

In August 2024, Vivian made several more scathing remarks about her father on Threads, calling him "pathetic" and a " serial adulterer."

Griffin has mainly stayed out of the public eye but joined his father at an American Express event in Miami in May 2024. "That’s my eldest son, Griffin, who was with me at the event," Musk wrote on X under a photo of the two.

Vivian said she doesn't consider all of Musk's children her siblings in a March 2025 interview with Teen Vogue.

"I will say I do not actually know how many siblings I have, if you include half-siblings. That's just a fun fact," she said. "It's really good for two truths and a lie. I found out about the Shivon Zilis thing the same time everyone else did."

In a March 2025 interview with YouTube influencer Hasan Piker, Vivian said that her transition isn't " some tragic character motivation" that led to her dad's political leanings.

“[Elon Musk] was not a liberal darling. I f------ know him, he was never on the left. It was a marketing scheme," she said.

## Kai, Saxon and Damian

Wilson gave birth to triplet boys named Kai, Saxon and Damian in 2006, two years after having twins. She revealed in a 2017 TedTalk that they were also conceived via IVF, but she and Musk have not discussed the children themselves publicly.

In a 2023 biography on the tech mogul, titled Elon Musk, author Walter Isaacson wrote about Damian, who he said became a vegetarian at age 8 to " decrease my carbon footprint."

Isaacson also mentioned that Damian is a classical music prodigy who excelled in math and physics. Musk's mom, Maye, even once told her son, "I think Damian is brighter than you."

## X Æ A-12

Elon Musk with son X on stage at the TIME Person of the Year function on Dec. 13, 2021, in New York City. Theo Wargo/Getty

Grimes and Musk welcomed their first child on May 4, 2020, after the singer announced her pregnancy with a picture of her baby bump back in January 2020. Their son, X Æ A-12, whose name was later changed to X Æ A-Xii, was in part named after the CIA's Lockheed A-12 reconnaissance plane.

Though nicknamed "X," Grimes broke down his pronunciation in her Instagram comment section. "It's just X, like the letter X," she wrote. "Then A.I.," she added. "Like how you said the letter A then I."

But Musk explained the pronunciation differently, saying on The Joe Rogan Experience podcast that "X" is spoken "like the letter" while "the 'Æ' is pronounced like 'ash.' "

While proudly stating that "A-12 was [his] contribution," he said it was Grimes who " mostly came up with the name." She even gave a thorough description of the meaning behind it on her X.

Elon Musk carries his son X Æ A-Xii on his shoulders in the Oval Office of the White House in Washington, DC, on February 11, 2025.

JIM WATSON/AFP via Getty

The boy later made headlines when he joined his dad for a tense meeting at X at the age of 2.

According to The Washington Post, Musk brought X Æ A-Xii to X's offices while meeting with Trust and Safety Office Yoel Roth in October 2022. The child was reportedly running around the building as Musk discussed the company's future. X Æ A-Xii also made himself comfortable in the conference room, which the newspaper reported "was strewn with toys."

In April 2023, X Æ A-Xii tagged along with his dad to the MMA Global Possible Conference in Miami. The little boy was seen playing with Musk on stage, which the audience found heartwarming.

Four months later, Grimes opened up about her son's love of spacecraft. "X knows a lot about rockets. It's crazy," she explained. "He knows more about rockets than me."

She even admitted that she was worried about his "obsession with space" after SpaceX's Starship rocket exploded after takeoff in April.

"When X saw Starship blow up, he had, like, a three-day PTSD meltdown," the mom of two said. "Every hour, he was waking up and going, 'Starship ...' and I had to rub his back."

In February 2025, X Æ A-Xii accompanied his dad on a visit to the Oval Office to witness President Donald Trump sign an executive order that gave the Department of Government Efficiency more power.

Grimes reacted to the news on X, writing that she wasn't aware her son was there and that she had only found out from a user on the platform.

"He should not be in public like this," the singer wrote. "I did not see this, thank u for alerting me. But I'm glad he was polite. Sigh."

After Musk showed up for a press conference in the Oval Office with a black eye in May 2025, he told a reporter he'd gotten the injury while roughhousing with X Æ A-Xii.

"I was walking around with Little X and I said, 'Go ahead and punch me in the face,' and he did," he said. "I didn't really feel much at the time but I guess it bruises up."

## Strider and Azure

Elon Musk and Shivon Zilis with twins Strider and Azure.

Walter Isaacson/Twitter

Musk secretly welcomed twins, son Strider and daughter Azure, with Shivon Zilis in November 2021, according to court documents published by Insider. The twins were born in Austin, Texas — just weeks before he and Grimes welcomed a baby girl via a surrogate.

The papers reveal that in April 2022, Musk and Zilis asked a Texan county court to change their babies' names so they would "have their father's last name and contain their mother's last name as part of their middle name."

The parents revealed the babies' names and sexes in September 2023, when they were 16 months old.

## Exa Dark Sideræl

Elon Musk and Grimes' daughter Exa.

Grimes/ X

Grimes revealed a year later in a Vanity Fair interview that she welcomed a baby girl via surrogate in December 2021, three months after the couple's public breakup. Named Exa Dark Sideræl, the singer-songwriter explained that her name has a double meaning.

Exa refers to a supercomputing term, exaFLOPS, while Dark represents "the unknown." She explained to the outlet, "People fear it but truly it's the absence of photons. Dark matter is the beautiful mystery of our universe."

The third part of Y's full name, Sideræl, is pronounced "sigh-deer-ee-el," according to Vanity Fair. Grimes described the word as "a more elven" spelling of sidereal, which she defined as "the true time of the universe, star time, deep space time, not our relative earth time."

The second meaning of Sideræl is a nod to Grimes' favorite Lord of the Rings character, Galadriel, who "chooses to abdicate the ring."

In March 2023, Grimes shared a rare photo of her daughter on Twitter — and revealed that the little girl is going by a new name.

"Normally we [don't] post her for her privacy, but she's fairly unrecognizable here since shes channeling Goku," she wrote in the comments, referring to a Dragon Ball character. The photo showed Musk's youngest in a red onesie with super blonde spiked hair.

In a separate comment, Grimes said: "She's Y now, or "Why?" or just "?" (But the government won't recognize that). curiosity, the eternal question, .. and such."

In August 2023, Grimes described her younger child as "a little engineer," and said, "she likes industrial shipping. She's very strange."

## Techno Mechanicus

Elon Musk and Grimes attend the Heavenly Bodies: Fashion & The Catholic Imagination Costume Institute Gala at The Metropolitan Museum of Art on May 7, 2018 in New York City. Neilson Barnard/Getty

Isaacson's biography about Musk revealed the birth of the Tesla founder's third child with Grimes. The couple secretly welcomed a second son, Techno Mechanicus, who also goes by “Tau," in June 2022.

“Tau is so amazing. He came out with eyes that could just see so deeply into your soul, with so much knowledge. He looks like a little Spock. He's definitely a Vulcan,” Grimes told Isaacson in the biography.

Following the book's release, Grimes wrote on X that she was keeping further details about her youngest child private.

"I wish I could show u how cute little Techno is but my priority rn is keeping my babies out of the public eye," she wrote. "Plz respect that at this time."

## Arcadia

In June 2024, Musk confirmed the arrival of his third child with Zilis. Their daughter, Arcadia, was born on Feb. 28, 2024.

"Mommy loves you with all her heart," Zilis wrote on X in honor of Arcadia's first birthday in February 2025.

## Seldon Lycurgus

Zilis announced on X in February 2025 that she and Musk had welcomed their fourth child, son Seldon Lycurgus. However, she did not reveal her baby boy's birthdate.

"Discussed with Elon, we felt it was better to share directly about our wonderful and incredible son Seldon Lycurgus. Built like a juggernaut, with a solid heart of gold. Love him so much," the mom of four wrote.

## Romulus

Ashley St. Clair and Elon Musk.

Ashley St. Clair/X; Andrew Harnik/Getty

In February 2025, St. Clair posted an announcement to X, revealing that she and Musk welcomed a child together in September 2024.

"Five months ago, I welcomed a new baby into the world. Elon Musk is the father. I have not previously disclosed this to protect our child's privacy and safety, but in recent days it has become clear that tabloid media intends to do so, regardless of the harm it will cause," she wrote.

"I intend to allow our child to grow in a normal and safe environment," St. Clair continued. "For that reason, I ask that the media honor our child's privacy, and refrain from invasive reporting."

It's unclear if St. Clair's child was born before or after Musk and Zilis welcomed baby No. 4.

The following month, Musk claimed in a post on X that though he hadn't yet established paternity of the child, he had " given Ashley $2.5M and am sending her $500k/year." Hours later, St. Clair responded, accusing Musk of withdrawing his support of their son to " maintain control and punish me for disobedience."

Another update came in April 2025, when the Wall Street Journal reported that St. Clair and Musk's child is named Romulus, and that a report from Labcorp revealed that Musk's "Probability of Paternity" was 99.9999%.

A spokesperson for St. Clair confirmed the results of the paternity test and Romulus' name to PEOPLE.

When Trump and Musk began publicly feuding in June 2025, St. Clair joked about her own public feud with the Tesla CEO in a post on X.

"Hey @realDonaldTrump lmk if you need any breakup advice," she wrote.

## Keeping up with Elon Musk's children

- Elon Musk has 13 children he has confirmed, and a possible 14th child whose paternity is now being determined by a New York court.
- Musk, the world's richest man, has six children with his ex-wife, Justine Wilson.
- Musk shares three children with musician Grimes.
- The tech billionaire also has four children with tech executive Shivon Zilis.

Elon Musk, the billionaire chief executive and technology entrepreneur, has built not just rockets and electric cars but an unusually large and complex family. Over more than two decades, he has fathered at least 14 children with multiple partners.

The scope of his family life aligns with views he has repeatedly expressed in public, including his embrace of the“pronatalist” movement, which argues that declining birthrates threaten long-term social and economic stability and encourages people — particularly those with means — to have more kids.

In a July 2021 post on X, Musk warned that “population collapse is potentially the greatest risk to the future of civilization.”

## Elon Musk's children, by relationship:

- Six children with his ex-wife, Justine Wilson, including their first child, a boy named Nevada, who died as an infant.
- Three children with musician Grimes, whose legal name is Claire Elise Boucher.
- Four children with tech executive Shivon Zilis.
- One child with conservative influencer Ashley St. Clair.

Walter Isaacson, who wrote a biography and Time magazine cover story about Musk, spoke about the businessman's views on family during a 2023 appearance on TODAY.

“He believes that people should have many more children,” Isaacson explained, adding that Musk personally "wants to have a lot of children.”

Here’s a closer look at Elon Musk's relationships with his kids.

## Nevada Alexander Musk (2002 -2002) — with Justine Wilson

Musk and his first wife welcomed their first child, a son, in 2022. The infant died at 10 weeks old from complications related to sudden infant death syndrome, according to the New York Times.

“My firstborn son died in my arms,” Musk wrote in a February 2022 email exchange reported by Business Insider India. “I felt his heartbeat.”

Later that year, Wilson refuted Musk's claim that he had been the one to hold their son in his final moments, writing on X: “A SIDS-related incident that put him on life support. He was declared brain-dead. And not that it matters to anyone except me because it is one of the most sacred and defining moments of my life, but I was the one who was holding him.”

## Griffin Musk (2004) — with Justine Wilson

After the death of their son, Nevada, Musk and Wilson welcomed their first set of multiple children: a pair of twins.

Griffin Musk and Vivian Wilson were conceived via in vitro fertilization, according to an October 2024 profile by the New York Times.

In May 2024, Musk commented on a photo shared on X that he and Griffin had attended an American Express event together in Miami.

"That’s my eldest son, Griffin, who was with me at the event," he wrote.

Griffin has largely remained out of public view, and unlike some of his siblings, he has not spoken publicly or attracted sustained media attention.

## Vivian Jenna Wilson (2004) — with Justine Wilson

Wilson, who was born in 2004, is a twin to her brother Griffin and has become one of Musk's most outspoken children in recent years.

In 2022, she legally changed her name and gender, saying in a court filing that both her gender identity and her desire to distance herself from her father informed the decision. “I no longer live with or wish to be related to my biological father in any way, shape or form," she wrote in the petition, according to the Associated Press.

Musk later said in a 2024 interview with the conservative commentator Jordan Peterson that Wilson had been “killed by the woke mind virus,” a remark that drew widespread criticism.

Shortly afterward, Wilson told NBC News that she had not spoken to her father in four years. “I am an adult. I am 20 years old. I am not a child,” she said. “My life should never be defined by my own choices.”

In a March 2025 profile for Teen Vogue, Wilson was sharply critical of her father, calling him "a pathetic man-child."

She said she was often unaware of the full extent of her family, adding, "I will say I do not actually know how many siblings I have, if you include half-siblings." she said in the interview. She said she learned about some of his children at the same time as the public, including one through a post on Reddit.

Speaking about her gender identity and coming out to her parent as transgender, Wilson claimed Musk "was not as supportive" as her mother and described the difficulties of securing medical care while estranged from him.

"I had not talked to him in months," she said, recalling the need to obtain parental consent for testosterone blockers and hormone replacement therapy.

## Kai Musk (2006) — with Justine Wilson

After the birth of the twins, Musk and Wilson went on to have triplets — all boys — in 2006. The three children are Kai, Saxon and Damian.

Their birth order has not been made public. Musk has occasionally referenced the triplets in public.

In Aug. 2024, he commented on a photograph posted on X showing him meeting India’s prime minister, writing that two of the boys were his sons, though he did not specify which ones.

## Saxon Musk (2006) — with Justine Wilson

Saxon is one of Musk and Wilson’s triplets, born in 2006. Musk has referenced his son multiple times on X.

"My 14-year-old son, Saxon, said he feels like 2021 will be a good year," Musk posted in January 2021. "I agree. Let us all make it so."

In June 2022, Musk w rote on the platform, "My son, Saxon, suggested having a party for the whole world, a world party day!"

## Damian Musk (2006) — with Justine Wilson

Damian is one of Musk and Wilson's triplets, born in 2006.

In 2021, Musk commented on a video shared on X of Damian playing a piano during a visit to a senior living community.

Two years after the birth of their triplets, in 2008, Musk and Wilson divorced, according to NBC News.

## X Æ A-Xii Musk (2020) — with Grimes

Musk and the Canadian musician Grimes had a son in May 2020.

The child was originally named X Æ A-12, but the name was later modified to X Æ A-Xii to comply with California birth-certificate regulations. His parents refer to him as X.

Shortly after the child’s birth Musk explained the name’s pronunciation on The Joe Rogan Experience, saying it is pronounced“X Ash A Twelve.” He added that the name was largely Grimes’s idea, with his own contribution coming in the reference to the A-12 aircraft.

Musk and Grimes announced their separation in Sept. 2021, later briefly rekindled their relationship, then separated again, describing themselves at the time as “semi-separated.”

In recent years, Musk has occasionally appeared in public with his son. In 2025, he brought X with him to the Oval Office, where the then-4-year-old drew attention with photographers and onlookers as Musk spoke with reporters. During the appearance, X made faces, climbed on the furniture and wandered near the Resolute desk, moments that quickly circulated online

## Strider and Azure Musk (2021) — with Shivon Zilis

In November 2021, Mr. Musk welcomed twins, Strider and Azure, with Shivon Zilis, a senior executive at Neuralink.

In his Time magazine cover story on Mr. Musk, the biographer Walter Isaacson described Ms. Zilis as Mr. Musk’s “intellectual companion on artificial intelligence” dating back to the founding of OpenAI eight years earlier. Mr. Isaacson also disclosed the twins’ names in the article and published a photograph of them.

A 2024 New York Times profile on Musk reported that he had built a $35 million “family compound” in Texas for all of his children and two of their mothers to live together. Zilis had reportedly moved into one of the homes on the compound with their children.

On Sept. 8, 2023, Zilis shared a video on X of her twins running around, with one of them yelling, “I love you.”

## Exa Dark Sideræl Musk (2021) — with Grimes

Musk and Grimes welcomed a daughter, Exa Dark Sideræl, via surrogate in Dec. 2021, just weeks after the birth of Musk’s twins with Shivon Zilis.

In 2023, Grimes shared on X that she had spoken with Zilis and discussed their plans for co-parenting.

“I spoke with Shivon at length finally, which was long overdue. This wasn’t her fault, plz don’t be angry at her! We respect each other a lot and we’re excited to become friends and have the kids grow up together,” she wrote.

She added, “Women are so often pitted against each other. Speaking with Shivon, it’s very evident she’s an amazing human and we both just want what’s best for our kids.”

Grimes told Vanity Fair in a March 2022 feature that the baby’s name is pronounced “sigh-deer-ee-el,” but nicknamed “Y.”

“There’s no real word for it,” she told the magazine when asked about her relationship status with Musk at the time. “I would probably refer to him as my boyfriend, but we’re very fluid. We live in separate houses. We’re best friends. We see each other all the time. ... We just have our own thing going on, and I don’t expect other people to understand it.”

In the interview, she also mentioned that she and Musk hoped to have more children. “We’ve always wanted at least three or four.”

On March 10, 2022, after the article was released, Grimes tweeted that she and Musk had broken up again.

## Techno Mechanicus Musk (2022) — with Grimes

Techno Mechanicus Musk, nicknamed Tau, was born in mid-June 2022. His existence was not publicly disclosed until Sept. 2023, when a New York Times review of Walter Isaacson’s biography of Musk revealed that he and Grimes had welcomed another child together.

Around that same time, Grimes referenced the child in a post on X, asking for privacy and writing,“I wish I could show u how cute little Techno is but my priority rn is keeping my babies out of the public eye.” She added, “Plz respect that at this time.”

Later that month, Grimes filed a petition in California to establish parental rights, part of a custody dispute that followed the couple’s on-and-off separation.

## Arcadia Musk (2024) — with Shivon Zilis

Musk and Zilis quietly welcomed a third child together in 2024. The child’s birth was not publicly announced at the time, and details about the newborn were initially limited.

After news of the birth became public, Musk dismissed suggestions that the child had been kept secret. “All our friends and family know,” he told Page Six in June 2024 “Failure to issue a press release, which would be bizarre, does not mean ‘secret.’”

On Feb. 28, 2025, Zilis celebrated Arcadia's first birthday on X.

She wrote, “Happy 1st birthday, darling Arcadia. Mommy loves you with all her heart.”

## Seldon Lycurgus (2025) — with Shivon Zilis

On Arcadia’s first birthday, Zilis announced that she and Musk had welcomed another child together. Writing on X, she said they had decided to share the news publicly at that moment, introducing their son as Seldon Lycurgus.

“Discussed with Elon and, in light of beautiful Arcadia’s birthday, we felt it was better to also just share directly about our wonderful and incredible son, Seldon Lycurgus. Built like a juggernaut, with a solid heart of gold. Love him so much,” she said.

Musk responded to her comment with a heart emoji.

## Romulus (2024) — with Ashley St. Clair

The child of the conservative influencer Ashley St. Clair, first identified in court filing as R.S.C., was born in Sept. 2024. In her petition, St. Clair included a photograph of Musk holding the infant, whom she identified as as their son.

In April 2025, The Wall Street Journal reported that Labcorp paternity test ordered by a New York court found a 99.9999 percent probability that Musk was the child’s father. The newspaper also reported that the boy’s name is Romulus.

The photo of Elon Musk with a baby Ashley St. Clair identified as their son in her court filing.Image obtained from the court filing alleging Elon’s paternity

Before the test results were made public, Musk said on X that he had provided St. Clair with $2.5 million and was sending her $500,000 a year, while stopping short of publicly acknowledging paternity.

“I don’t know if the child is mine or not, but am not against finding out,” he wrote. “No court order is needed.”

The dispute escalated after St. Clair made public comments expressing support for transgender people and for access to gender-affirming care for minors. In response, Musk said in interviews and on social that he planned to seek custody, arguing that he was concerned about his son’s upbringing. In a statement to CNN, he said he intended to file for custody, framing the issue as one of protecting the child’s welfare.

In Feb. 2025, St. Clair has petitioned a New York court seeking to establish Musk as the father of her baby boy and asking for sole custody.

Also, a previous version of this story stated that Musk and Grimes’ son, X Æ A-Xii, was born in May 2021, and their daughter, Exa Dark Sideræl, was born in December 2020. X was born in May 2020, and Exa was born in December 2021. Additionally, a previous version of this story stated that Grimes filed a court petition to establish parental rights in October 2023. She filed the court petition in September 2023.

# Elon Musk’s 14 Children: All About the Controversial Billionaire’s Many Kids and Their Mothers

Mar 2, 2026 1:36 PM EST

By Allie Nelson

0

Add us on

Elon Musk is the founder, CEO and chief engineer of SpaceX, the CEO of Tesla, Inc., the owner and former CEO of Twitter (now X), the co-founder of Neuralink and OpenAI, and the father of 14 children.

Musk’s reasoning for fathering such a robust number of offspring could come from his alleged desire (expressed privately to baby mama Ashley St. Clair, according to an April 2025 report from The Wall Street Journal) to create a “legion-level” of children before the end of the world. To achieve these legion numbers—traditionally thought to be a unit of “thousands of soldiers,” according to ancient Roman military parlance—and “before the apocalypse,” as he allegedly texted to St. Clair, the billionaire believes the use of surrogates would be required. The WSJ reported that Musk has been using his social media platform X to seek out more women to have his babies.

In an article published by The New York Times in May 2025, St. Clair claimed that Musk told her he would offer his sperm to anyone who wanted a baby. She also alleged that the billionaire said he had fathered a child with an unnamed Japanese pop star. “He made it seem like it was just his altruism and he generally believed these people should just have children,” St. Clair told the outlet.

During a November 2025 episode of the People by WTF podcast, Musk joked that he has an “army” of kids, adding, “I’m trying to get an entire Roman legion.” He also said that if fertility rates continue to decline around the world, he fears humanity will “disappear.”

Here is everything we know about the billionaire’s brood.

Related: What We Know About Elon Musk’s Net Worth

## How many kids does Elon Musk have?

Elon Musk is the father of 14 children. His first child, son Nevada Alexander Musk, died at just 10 weeks old as a result of SIDS in 2002. The rest of his kids range in age from 1 to 21 years old.

In February 2025, conservative influencer Ashley St. Clair took to social media to claim she gave birth to one of Musk’s children. Though Musk has not publicly claimed the baby, The Wall Street Journal reported in April 2025 that a court ordered him to take a paternity test and a Labcorp report stated the “Probability of Paternity” was 99.9999%.

## What are the names of Elon Musk’s kids?

The names of Elon Musk’s 14 children are: Nevada, Griffin, Vivian, Kai, Saxon, Damian, X Æ A-Xii, Azure, Strider, Exa Dark Sideræl, Techno Mechanicus, Seldon Lycurgus, Arcadia and Romulus.

## Who are the mothers of Elon Musk’s kids?

Elon Musk has had 14 children (one of whom died in infancy) with four different women. They include:

### Justine Wilson

Justine Wilson Ryan Miller/Getty Images

Musk’s original set of six children was with his first wife, Canadian author Justine Wilson, to whom he was married from 2000 to 2008. Wilson has been candid about the marriage, stating, “I was a starter wife” as part of a revealing essay in Marie Claire.

Related: The Scoop on Bill and Melinda Gates’ 3 Kids and Their Inheritance

### Grimes

Grimes and Elon Musk attend an event in New York City, May 2018 John Shearer/Getty Images

Musk shares three children with his former romantic partner, Canadian singer Grimes, who gave birth to their son X Æ A-Xii in May 2020. They then welcomed a daughter, Exa Dark Sideræl, via surrogate in December 2021. Their third child, Techno Mechanicus, nicknamed Tau, was kept private until author Walter Isaacson referred to Grimes as “the mother of three of Musk’s children” in his book about the billionaire, Elon Musk.

Grimes’ real name is Claire Elise Boucher.

### Shivon Zilis

In November 2021, between the birth of his first two children with Grimes, Musk welcomed a set of twins with employee Shivon Zilis, the Neuralink director of operations and special projects. Musk and Zilis welcomed their third child together in 2024.

In February 2025, Zilis took to social media to announce the birth of another child with Musk, Seldon Lycurgus. She did not say when the baby was born.

“Discussed with Elon and, in light of beautiful Arcadia’s birthday, we felt it was better to also just share directly about our wonderful and incredible son Seldon Lycurgus. Built like a juggernaut, with a solid heart of gold. Love him so much ♥️,” she tweeted. Musk replied with a single heart emoji.

### Ashley St. Clair

On Feb. 14, 2025, conservative influencer Ashley St. Clair posted an announcement on social media in which she claimed to have welcomed Musk’s 13th child five months earlier. “Five months ago, I welcomed a new baby into the world. Elon Musk is the father. I have not previously disclosed this to protect our child’s privacy and safety, but in recent days it has become clear that tabloid media intends to do so, regardless of the harm it will cause,” she wrote. St. Clair did not divulge the child’s name or gender.

St. Clair sued Musk on Feb. 21, seeking full custody of the son that she says they share and asking the court to order Musk to take a paternity test. St. Clair claimed in the paternity petition that she began dating Musk in May 2023 and that she and Musk had sex in early January 2024, which is when she believes her son was conceived, according to court documents obtained by Page Six.

The conservative influencer said in the filing that she believes Musk is the father of her child because she “did not have sexual intercourse with any other male during the time the child was conceived,” per Page Six. An order for sealing the case from the public was granted in a court document filed on March 14.

In a March 31 post on X, Musk said, “I don’t know if the child is mine or not, but am not against finding out. No court order is needed.” He also claimed in the post that he had paid St. Clair $2.5 million and was sending her $500,000 a year. St. Clair responded in an X post hours later, writing, “Elon, we asked you to confirm paternity through a test before our child (who you named) was even born. You refused.” In the post, St. Clair accused Musk of withdrawing most of his support of their son to “maintain control and punish me for ‘disobedience.'”

On April 15, the WSJ reported that the child’s name is Romulus and that a court-ordered paternity test came back with a 99.9999% probability that Musk is the father.

Musk allegedly offered St. Clair $15 million plus $100,000 a month in support to keep quiet about the child and her relationship with Musk, according to the WSJ report. After St. Clair claimed on X that Musk was the father of her child, Musk allegedly rescinded the $15 million offer. St. Clair claims that her monthly support payments dropped to $40,000 after she took Musk to court, and dropped again to $20,000 when the WSJ published its report.

While St. Clair was pregnant, Musk allegedly suggested that they bring in surrogates to have more of their children faster. “To reach legion-level before the apocalypse, we will need to use surrogates,” Musk reportedly said to St. Clair in a text message viewed by the WSJ.

During Musk’s falling-out with President Donald Trump in June 2025, St. Clair made a tongue-in-cheek offer to Trump on X. “hey @realDonaldTrump lmk if u need any breakup advice,” she wrote.

In August 2025, St. Clair shared the first episode of her Bad Advice podcast on X, where she said she was facing eviction “after a year of unplanned career suicide, many questionable life choices, and a gap in my LinkedIn profile that cannot legally be explained.” She later deleted the podcast episode.

Musk wrote on X in January 2026 that he would be filing for full custody of his and St. Clair’s son. His announcement came a day after St. Clair apologized for her past transphobic comments and said she was now trying to “advocate for those within the trans community.” In his post, Musk said he was seeking full custody because of St. Clair’s statements “implying she might transition a one-year-old boy.”

Two days later, St. Clair responded to Musk’s custody filing announcement during an appearance on CNN. “I’m not at liberty to discuss it further, but I think anyone with more than a third-grade reading comprehension level knows what I was saying there,” she said.

On Jan. 15, St. Clair sued Musk’s xAI artificial intelligence company, alleging that xAI’s Grok tool was used to create sexually explicit deepfakes of her.

## Who are Elon Musk’s kids?

### Nevada Alexander Musk

Musk’s firstborn son, Nevada Alexander Musk, was born in 2002. Tragically, young Nevada passed away from SIDS at only 10 weeks old. Nevada’s mother, author Justine Wilson, wrote about the heartbreaking loss in an essay for Marie Claire in 2010.

“Nevada went down for a nap, placed on his back as always, and stopped breathing … By the time the paramedics resuscitated him, he had been deprived of oxygen for so long that he was brain dead. He spent three days on life support in a hospital in Orange County before we made the decision to take him off it. I held him in my arms when he died,” Wilson wrote.

Musk has remained mostly silent (at least in public) about the loss of his son. However, in an email expressing his sympathy to a father who lost his 18-year-old son in a Tesla crash in 2018, he wrote, “There is nothing worse than losing a child. My firstborn son died in my arms. I felt his heartbeat.”

### Griffin Musk

Following the devastating loss of their first child, Musk and his then-wife, Justine Wilson, used IVF to have more children. As a result, Griffin and his twin Vivian, were born in April 2004. The twins are now 21.

Wilson wrote about her journey with IVF, which was complicated by her grief over Nevada’s tragic loss. “I buried my feelings … coping with Nevada’s death by making my first visit to an IVF clinic less than two months later. Elon and I planned to get pregnant again as swiftly as possible,” Wilson wrote in Marie Claire.

### Vivian Jenna Wilson

Vivian Jenna Wilson was born alongside her twin, Griffin, in April 2004. In 2022, at age 18, she filed to legally change her name and gender, seeking recognition of her gender as female and the issuance of a new birth certificate reflecting both of these changes. Vivian, who’s now 21, sought to change her last name to that of her mother, leaving behind her father’s surname.

In the petition, Vivian explained her reasoning, including her desire to drop her father’s last name, writing, “Gender Identity and the fact that I no longer live with or wish to be related to my biological father in any way, shape or form.”

Musk has given his own explanation for why he believes Vivian, who was called Xavier at birth, has fallen out with him, attributing the takeover of elite schools and universities by neo-Marxists. “It’s full-on communism … and a general sentiment that if you’re rich, you’re evil. It [the relationship] may change, but I have very good relationships with all the others [children]. Can’t win them all.”

In a July 2024 post on X, Musk used Vivian’s birth name, known as deadnaming, and said that she was “not a girl.” During an interview with media personality Jordan Peterson, the billionaire claimed that Vivian was “dead, killed by the woke mind virus,” and said he’d been “tricked” into authorizing gender-affirming care for her when she was 16.

In response to Musk’s claims, Vivian told NBC News that Musk hadn’t been tricked and understood the treatment he approved for her. She also said that he’d been an unsupportive father and was “cruel” toward her as a child for exhibiting feminine traits. “He was cold,” she said. “He’s very quick to anger. He is uncaring and narcissistic.”

### Kai Musk, Saxon Musk and Damian Musk

Musk’s then-wife, Canadian author Justine Wilson, gave birth to triplet sons Kai, Saxon and Damian Musk in January 2006. The triplets turned 20 this year. Both Wilson and Elon have declined to speak publicly about the triplets at any great length, though Wilson did confirm the trio was also conceived via IVF in a 2017 TEDx Talk.

Musk and Wilson divorced in 2008, two years after the triplets were born. In a 2010 op-ed for Business Insider, he wrote that he paid his ex $20,000 a month in child support in addition to Wilson’s living expenses and the salaries of the children’s nannies.

He explained, “Custody of our five children is split evenly. Almost all of my non-work waking hours are spent with my [children], and they are the love of my life.”

After founding the school Ad Astra in 2014, Musk pulled his children from private school and enrolled them there. Ad Astra, meaning “to the stars” in Latin, began at the SpaceX campus with just 50 students before transitioning to an online school called Astra Nova. The school does not have a grading system and offers courses in artificial intelligence, applied science and coding.

However, in a 2021 interview on the Clubhouse app, Musk admitted that the majority of his children’s education may have come from another source.

“Well, my observation is my kids were mostly educated by YouTube and Reddit, and then you know, and their—I guess—classmates. And I guess there were lessons as well, but judging by the amount of time they spent online, it seemed like most of their education is actually coming from online,” Musk said.

### X Æ A-Xii (originally X Æ A-12)

Elon Musk and singer Grimes welcomed their first child together on May 4, 2020. Their son, who is now 5 years old, was initially called X Æ A-12, but his name was later changed to X Æ A-Xii.

Grimes explained the name on X, writing:

“•X, the unknown variable ⚔️

•Æ, my elven spelling of Ai (love &/or Artificial intelligence)

•A-12 = precursor to SR-17 (our favorite aircraft). No weapons, no defenses, just speed. Great in battle, but non-violent 🤍

+

(A=Archangel, my favorite song)

(⚔️🐁 metal rat).”

Grimes revealed her pregnancy in January 2020 with a photo of her baby bump.

Related: From Amazon to Space, What We Know About Jeff Bezos’ Sky-High Net Worth

### Azure and Strider

Musk and Neuralink director of operations and special projects Shivon Zilis welcomed twins in November 2021, around the same time Musk and Grimes welcomed a daughter via surrogate. Azure and Strider are 4 years old.

### Exa Dark Sideræl Musk

Just a month after welcoming a set of twins with Shivon Zilis, Elon Musk and Grimes welcomed a daughter, Exa Dark Sideræl Musk, born via surrogate in December 2021. The parents nicknamed the child “Y” due to her brother having the moniker “X.” Exa is 4 years old.

### Techno Mechanicus (a.k.a. Tau)

The birth of Musk’s third child with Grimes, Techno, was revealed in Walter Isaacson’s 2023 biography. Shortly after the news became widespread in September 2023, Grimes confirmed it herself on X. “I wish I could show u how cute little Techno is, but my priority rn is keeping my babies out of the public eye,” she wrote. Techno was born in June 2022 and is now 3 years old.

### Arcadia

Elon Musk welcomed his 12th child (and third with Neuralink executive Shivon Zilis) sometime in the first half of 2024. Although the news didn’t break publicly for months, Musk told Page Six that the child wasn’t a “secret.”

“As for ‘secretly fathered,’ that is also false,” Musk told the outlet. “All our friends and family know. Failure to issue a press release, which would be bizarre, does not mean ‘secret.’”

The child’s name was not revealed publicly until February 2025, when Zilis tweeted both Arcadia’s name and an announcement about the birth of another child with Musk. Arcadia turned one in 2025.

### Romulus

Conservative influencer Ashley St. Clair claimed on Feb. 14, 2025, that she welcomed a child with Musk in September 2024. “I have not previously disclosed this to protect our child’s privacy and safety, but in recent days it has become clear that tabloid media intends to do so, regardless of the harm it will cause,” she tweeted.

St. Clair sued Musk on Feb. 21, seeking full custody of the son that she says they share and asking the court to order Musk to take a paternity test. St. Clair claimed in the filing that she believes Musk is the father of her child because she “did not have sexual intercourse with any other male during the time the child was conceived,” according to court documents obtained by Page Six.

On April 15, the WSJ reported that the child’s name is Romulus and that a court-ordered paternity test shows a 99.9999% probability that Musk is the father.

Romulus turned 1 in 2025.

In January 2026, Musk announced via X that he would be filing for full custody of Romulus.

### Seldon Lycurgus

Zilis announced the birth of another child with Musk in February 2025, tweeting, “Discussed with Elon and, in light of beautiful Arcadia’s birthday, we felt it was better to also just share directly about our wonderful and incredible son Seldon Lycurgus. Built like a juggernaut, with a solid heart of gold. Love him so much ♥️.” Musk replied with a single heart emoji.

They did not say when the baby was born.

Related: They Don’t Call Him a Shark for Nothing: Mark Cuban’s 10-Figure Net Worth in 2026

## Why did Grimes accuse Elon Musk of not letting her see their son?

In September 2023, after Musk biographer Walter Isaacson posted the first photos of Musk’s twins with Shivon Zilis, Grimes responded somewhat shockingly, suggesting that Musk is not letting her see one of their sons (although she didn’t make clear which son she was referring to).

“Tell Shivon to unblock me and tell Elon to let me see my son or plz respond to my lawyer. I have never even been allowed to see a photo of these children until this moment, despite the situation utterly ripping my family apart,” Grimes wrote in the since-deleted tweet.

She subsequently apologized for the comment. “As u can imagine, that was a very gut-level reaction to a thing that has been very hard for me,” she wrote. “Communication about the twins wasn’t handled super well in the past, but I now totally understand what happened and totally forgive the situation.”

Grimes went on to explain that she and Zilis have talked and are now on good terms. “Women are so often pitted against each other. Speaking with Shivon, it’s very evident she’s an amazing human and we both just want what’s best for our kids.”

In September 2023, Musk sued for custody of the children he shares with Grimes in Texas, the location of his business headquarters, according to Business Insider. That month, Grimes countersued, filing a petition to establish a “parental relationship” in a San Francisco, Calif., court. The singer claimed that Musk was withholding access to her kids and prevented them from seeing their terminally ill maternal grandmother, the Daily Mail reported.

Grimes and Musk settled their custody dispute in Texas in August 2024, according to Business Insider. The terms of the settlement and the status of Grimes’ countersuit are unclear.

In November 2024, Grimes commented on the custody battle on X, claiming that she hadn’t seen one of her children for five months.

“Spent a year locked in battle in a state with terrible mothers rights having my instagram posts and modeling used as reasons I shouldn’t have my kids and fighting and detaching from the love of my life as he becomes unrecognizable to me, with a fraction of his resources (or iq/ strategy experience), all the while I didn’t see one of my babies for 5 months,” Grimes wrote. “And this is only what can be said publicly, since most of my experience these last years should remain behind closed doors.”

## Why does Elon Musk have so many kids?

Elon Musk has been very vocal about the reasoning behind his large number of offspring. He tweeted in July 2022, “Doing my best to help the underpopulation crisis. A collapsing birth rate is the biggest danger civilization faces by far.”

He expressed the same sentiments in December 2021 at The Wall Street Journal’s annual CEO Council, where he said there are “not enough people.”

He continued, “I think one of the biggest risks to civilization is the low birth rate and the rapidly declining birth rate. Please look at the numbers—if people don’t have more children, civilization is going to crumble, mark my words.”Related: Larry Ellison’s Net Worth in 2026: What To Know About One of the World’s Richest Billionaires

## How do you say Elon Musk’s kids’ names?

The pronunciations for the majority of Elon Musk’s children’s names are pretty self-explanatory. However, it’s understandable if you need some help with saying the names of his children with singer Grimes, X Æ A-Xii and Exa Dark Sideræl Musk.

Both Grimes and Elon have given conflicting pronunciation explanations for X Æ A-Xii, who is nicknamed “X.”

Grimes tweeted the following explanation: “It’s just X, like the letter X. Then A.I. Like how you said the letter A then I.”

However, Elon explained, “X…like the letter…the ‘Æ’ is pronounced like ‘ash.'”

We’d probably stick with calling him “X” too!

According to Grimes, daughter Exa Dark Sideræl Musk’s name has a double meaning, with “Exa” referring to a supercomputing term, exaFLOPS, and “Dark” representing “the unknown.”

Grimes further explained, “People fear it, but truly it’s the absence of photons. Dark matter is the beautiful mystery of our universe.”

According to Vanity Fair, the third part of the young child’s name, “Sideræl,” is pronounced, “sigh-deer-ee-el.”

Grimes said the word was “a more elven” spelling of sidereal, a word she explained as “the true time of the universe, star time, deep space time, not our relative earth time,” in addition to being a nod to Grimes’ favorite character from Lord of the Rings, who “chooses to abdicate the ring.”

Grimes and Elon have nicknamed their daughter “Y” as a nod to their son’s nickname of “X.”

In a March 2023 comment on Twitter accompanying a rare picture of the child, Grimes elaborated, “She’s Y now, or ‘Why?’ or just ‘?’ (But the government won’t recognize that). curiosity, the eternal question, .. and such.”

Like his father, X Æ A-Xii loves all things outer space. "X knows a lot about rockets. It's crazy," Grimes once told Wired. "He knows more about rockets than me." The singer added that when SpaceX's Starship rocket exploded in April 2023, the toddler was distraught. "He had, like, a three-day PTSD meltdown," she recalled. "Every hour, he was waking up and going, 'Starship ...' and I had to rub his back."

# Elon Musk’s 14 Children and Their Mothers (That We Know Of): A Handy Guide

Tesla and Neuralink exec Shivon Zilis (a former advisor to OpenAI) and the musician Grimes each have multiple children with the tech bajillionaire. But they're not the only moms.

By Kase Wickman

March 5, 2025

Andrew Harnik/Getty Images.

Elon Musk is a real quantitative guy, it would seem. He wants lots of the things he wants: companies, money, children with his genetic signature.

And, in most people’s opinion, 14 publicly known children is a lot of children. That’s where Musk’s spawn tally currently stands, as far as the general public is aware. Those “as far as we know” caveats aren’t for comedy, either: The Musk kid count continues to climb, with news of two new children fathered by the novelty t-shirt enthusiast emerging this year already. If we keep going at this one baby per month rate, things are going to get weird. Or…weirder.

When 26-year-old conservative influencer Ashley St. Clair announced on February 14 that she has a five-month-old son fathered by Musk, the number of known mini Musks stood at 13, a tidy baker’s dozen. Then, just two weeks later, on February 28— oop!—he did it again. Neuralink executive Shivon Zilis, with whom Musk shares at least three other children (again, that we know of), took to social media to announce the existence of another child, bringing the (ibid: known) total up to 14. A Cybertruck can fit three car seats across (two rear-facing, as infant seats require) in the backseat, and Musk has at least eight children born in 2020 and after who would still need boosters or car seats. That’s three Cybertrucks, just to fit them all for a theoretical blended family field trip. The good news is that those eight kids have three different mothers, so they at least have enough drivers.

Including St. Clair and Zilis, four women have identified themselves as Musk’s partners in progeny.

In April 2025, the Wall Street Journal confirmed with “99.999%” certainty, according to lab analysis, that Musk was the father of St. Clair’s son, and reported that Musk had previously offered her $15 million and $100,000 a month in child support for her silence. She declined.

Musk recently joked on the social media platform he owns, X (formerly Twitter), that he was gonna need a bigger spaceship to shuttle all his offspring around. (He also has a child he calls X, not to be confused with SpaceX, which is another of his companies. Musk has the X factor, one supposes.) As for the rest of us, keeping track of the billionaire’s known genetic associates is a task, to say the least.

Herewith, a guide.

## Nevada Alexander

Born: May 18, 2002 Mother: Justine Wilson

Musk and his first wife, Justine Wilson, married in January 2000. In an essay for Marie Claire, Wilson wrote that as they danced at their wedding reception, Musk told her “I am the alpha in this relationship.” Later in the relationship, he’d tell her that if she was his employee, he’d fire her. The pair welcomed a baby boy, Nevada Alexander, in May 2002. The baby tragically died of complications from Sudden Infant Death Syndrome at 10 weeks old.

“Nevada went down for a nap, placed on his back as always, and stopped breathing,” Wilson wrote in the essay. That same week, Musk sold PayPal to eBay. Wilson wrote that she struggled with the loss of their child. “Elon made it clear that he did not want to talk about Nevada’s death,” she explained. “I didn’t understand this, just as he didn’t understand why I grieved openly, which he regarded as ‘emotionally manipulative.’”

## Vivian Jenna and Griffin

Musk with second wife Talulah Riley and his twins, mothered by Justine Wilson, in 2010. Mark Lennihan/AP.

Born: April 15, 2004 Mother: Justine Wilson

Though Nevada’s death sent Justine Wilson on what she called in the essay “a years-long inward spiral of depression and distraction,” she began IVF treatments two months after her first child’s death. In April 2004, she gave birth to twins. In April 2022, one of them came out as transgender, and petitioned to change her legal gender and name to Vivian Jenna Wilson, taking her mother’s maiden name, which was granted in June 2022. In legal documents, Vivian wrote that her reasons for requesting the name and gender changes on her new birth certificate were “Gender Identity and the fact that I no longer live with or wish to be related to my biological father in any way, shape or form.”

In July 2024, Musk wrote on X that his child was “born gay and slightly autistic, two traits that contribute to gender dysphoria.” Musk also said that Vivian had picked out jackets for Musk and called them “fabulous!” as a four-year-old. “But he was not a girl.”

Vivian Wilson fired back in a series of messages on Threads. “This entire thing is completely made up and there’s a reason for this,” Vivian wrote in part. “He doesn’t know what I was like as a child because he quite simply wasn’t there, and in the little time that he was I was relentlessly harassed for my femininity and queerness. Obviously he can’t say that, so I’ve been reduced to a happy little stereotype f*g-ing along to use at his discretion. I think that says a lot about how he views queer people and children in general.”

In a 2022 interview with the Financial Times after Vivian filed her petition, Musk blamed her education for turning her against him, calling the teachings “full-on communism.” “It [the relationship] may change, but I have very good relationships with all the others [children],” he said. “Can’t win them all.”

Vivian's twin, Griffin, largely stays out of the spotlight, but according to Musk, accompanied his father to an event in Miami in May 2024.

## Kai, Saxon, and Damian

Born: January 2006 Mother: Justine Wilson

Triplets Kai, Saxon, and Damian, conceived via IVF, were born in January 2006. Details about the three boys have been kept largely private, though Walter Isaacson wrote in a biography of Musk that Damian had become a vegetarian at age eight to “decrease [his] carbon footprint,” and that he was also a musical prodigy. In September 2008, Wilson and Musk announced that they were divorcing.

## X Æ A-12

Musk with his son, X, in the Oval Office. Andrew Harnik/Getty Images.

Born: May 4, 2020 Mother: Grimes (Claire Boucher)

In May 2020, musician Grimes and Musk were a couple, and welcomed son X Æ A-12, whose name was later slightly tweaked to X Æ A-Xii. He was conceived via IVF. While Grimes wrote in Instagram comments that her eldest son’s name was pronounced “just X, like the letter X, then A.I. Like how you said the letter A then I,” Musk had another answer, though he agreed that X, what the child is still typically called now, is pronounced “like the letter.” However, he said on The Joe Rogan Experience, “the ‘Æ’ is pronounced like ‘ash.’”

The last part of the child’s name is a tribute to the CIA’s Lockheed A-12 spy plane. Musk, who suggested the inclusion, called it “the Archangel-12, the precursor to the SR-71, the coolest plane ever.”

Recently, little X was seen badgering Musk in the Oval Office during a press conference, whispering at President Donald Trump to stop talking. According to sources who said that Musk has been sleeping in his office across the street from the White House, X is “around quite a bit.”

Grimes reacted to her eldest son’s presence at the Oval Office meeting on X. “He should not be in public like this,” she wrote. “I did not see this, thank u for alerting me. But I’m glad he was polite. Sigh.”

## Strider and Azure

Born: November 2021 Mother: Shivon Zilis

In November 2021, Musk secretly welcomed another set of twins—daughter Azure and son Strider—with Shivon Zilis, a top executive at his AI company Neuralink, news that was revealed in July 2022. At the time, Musk seemed to wink at the situation in a tweet: “Doing my best to help the underpopulation crisis,” he wrote. “A collapsing birth rate is the biggest danger civilization faces by far. Mark my words, they are sadly true.”

On February 15, 2025, the day after St. Clair came forward claiming that she'd had a child with Musk, Zilis shared a photo on X of herself posing, smiling, with the twins, captioning it, “Lil loves of my life.” Musk responded minutes later with a tweet of an emoji face surrounded with hearts.

Then on February 25, Zilis, whose bio lists her as being based in Palo Alto, Calif., shared a photo of the twins looking out across Washington, D.C.'s Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool.

## Exa Dark Sideræl Musk

Elon Musk and Grimes attend the Heavenly Bodies: Fashion & The Catholic Imagination Costume Institute Gala at The Metropolitan Museum of Art on May 7, 2018 in New York City. Dia Dipasupil

Born: December 2021 Mother: Grimes (Claire Boucher)

Musk had a second child with Grimes, daughter Exa Dark Sideræl Musk, who made her presence known during a Vanity Fair interview. When writer Devin Gordon heard a baby crying upstairs and asked Grimes what was going on, she first seemed to panic. From the profile:

> “I’m not at liberty to speak on these things,” she begins, and then all in a tumble says: “Whatever is going on with family stuff, I just feel like kids need to stay out of it, and X is just out there. I mean, I think E is really seeing him as a protégé and bringing him to everything and stuff.… X is out there. His situation is like that. But, yeah, I don’t know.”

Musk and Grimes were “ semi-separated,” in Musk’s words, though Grimes said of the relationship, “I would probably refer to him as my boyfriend, but we’re very fluid. We live in separate houses. We’re best friends. We see each other all the time…. We just have our own thing going on, and I don’t expect other people to understand it,” by the time the baby was born via surrogate in December 2021. Her name is Exa Dark Sideræl Musk, but they usually call her Y. Sometimes they call her Sailor Mars.

Grimes explained the origins of the baby’s unusual name: “Exa” is for the supercomputing term exaFLOPS, “Dark” is “the unknown. People fear it, but truly it’s the absence of photons. Dark matter is the beautiful mystery of our universe.” The last part is a nod to Lord of the Rings and the elven Galadriel.

“I was fighting for Odysseus Musk,” she told VF. “A girl named Odysseus is my dream.”

Of course, this was the third child Musk welcomed in the span of two-ish months, though his twins with Zilis were not yet public knowledge.

## Techno Mechanicus

Born: June 2022 Mother: Grimes (Claire Boucher)

Isaacson’s September 2023 biography of Musk revealed that he had welcomed another son with Grimes, born in June 2022. Named Techno Mechanicus, the parents call him Tau.

“Tau is so amazing,” Grimes told Isaacson in the book. “He came out with eyes that could just see so deeply into your soul, with so much knowledge. He looks like a little Spock. He’s definitely a Vulcan.”

Following the book’s publication, Grimes issued a statement on social media saying, essentially, that she and Zilis were cool now, and that she wanted to protect baby Tau’s privacy as much as she could.

“I wish I could show u how cute little Techno is but my priority rn is keeping my babies out of the public eye,” she wrote. “Plz respect that at this time.”

“I spoke with Shivon at length finally, which was long overdue. This wasn’t her fault, plz don’t be angry at her! We respect each other a lot and we’re excited to become friends and have the kids grow up together,” she also said. “Women are so often pitted against each other. Speaking with Shivon, it’s very evident she’s an amazing human and we both just want what’s best for our kids.”

## Arcadia

Born: March 28, 2024 Mother: Shivon Zilis

In June 2024, Musk confirmed he welcomed a third child with Zilis. Details such as the baby’s name, sex, and date of birth were not shared at the time. The baby was not a secret, Musk told Page Six, he just…didn’t really announce its birth.

“As for ‘secretly fathered,’ that is also false,” he told Page Six. “All our friends and family know. Failure to issue a press release, which would be bizarre, does not mean ‘secret.’”

On February 28, 2025, however, Zilis revealed all three pieces of information in a tweet.

“Happy 1st birthday, darling Arcadia. Mommy loves you with all her heart,” Zilis wrote. You have to give her points for efficiency in sharing the information. DOGE would be proud. A few hours later, she had yet more family news to share, but more on that in a moment.

## Romulus

Born: September-ish 2024 Mother: Ashley St. Clair

On February 14, 2025, St. Clair announced that she was mother to a five-month-old baby, and that Musk was the father. She alleged that he had insisted that she keep her pregnancy and the baby’s existence a secret, and that by his request, she had not included Musk’s name on the baby’s birth certificate. She went public, she claimed, after being hounded by tabloid reporters. Musk, she said in the days following, had not been in touch since. In April 2025, lab tests showed that Musk is indeed the baby's genetic father, and the Wall Street Journal revealed the tot's first name: Romulus.

## Seldon Lycurgus

Born: ???, 2025 Mother: Shivon Zilis

About two hours after her tweet-reveal of details about daughter Arcadia, Zilis had another first birthday gift for her daughter and the news-hungry world: A little brother named Seldon Lycurgus. Unlike his alleged child with St. Clair, Musk appears to acknowledge this one, responding to Zilis’ news drop with a single heart emoji in a reply tweet nine minutes later.

“Discussed with Elon and, in light of beautiful Arcadia’s birthday, we felt it was better to also just share directly about our wonderful and incredible son Seldon Lycurgus,” Zilis tweeted on February 28, 2025. “Built like a juggernaut, with a solid heart of gold. Love him so much.”

Lycurgus was a lawgiver in Sparta, to continue along Musk's theme of Greek mythology being his Roman Empire.

Lucky number 14, as they say.

# Inside Elon Musk’s family life including daughter who branded him ‘pathetic manchild’ 

 

Emily Bashforth| Live News reporter

 Published June 6, 2026 1:00pm 

 

Elon Musk has quite the brood (Picture: Getty)

Elon Musk repeatedly makes headlines for his astronomical wealth, feuds with fellow CEOs, controversial X updates, and Donald Trump endorsements – but his family life is also pretty intriguing.

The Tesla founder, 54, has welcomed children with four different women over the last two decades. However, it was reported by The Wall Street Journal in 2025 that the ‘true number of [his] children is much higher than publicly known’.

His foray into fatherhood began in 2002, when he and his Canadian author wife Justine Wilson welcomed son Nevada Alexander. Sadly, at just 10 weeks old, Musk’s firstborn died of sudden infant death syndrome (SIDS).

Since then, tech billionaire Musk has continued expanding his brood and has been open about his views on procreation, claiming that falling birth rates pose a grave risk to humanity.

While he hasn’t revealed many details about his offspring, the prominent pronatalist has praised his contribution to ‘the underpopulation crisis’ while encouraging others to have more kids.

‘A collapsing birth rate is the biggest danger civilisation faces by far,’ he wrote on X in 2022.

 

The Tesla founder has welcomed children with four different women (Picture: Brendan Smialowski/AFP via Getty Images)

## How many children does Elon Musk have?

In total, Musk has 14 children that we know of.

During his first marriage to Wilson, 53, from 2000 to 2008, he welcomed six children. They used IVF to conceive following Nevada’s death.

In 2004, the former couple had twins Griffin and Vivian, and in 2006, they had triplets Kai, Saxon, and Damian.

Following his divorce from Wilson, Musk had a child with singer Grimes (real name Claire Elise Boucher), whom he started dating in 2018.

They caused quite a stir in 2020 when they named their baby boy X Æ A-12, which was later formally changed to AE A-XII, where XII is 12 in Roman numerals, since California does not accept Greek combo letters or numerals in names.

Continuing the theme of ensuring their children would have the most unique names in their class, Grimes revealed in December 2021 that she and Musk had welcomed daughter Exa Dark Sideræl via surrogate.

 

Musk has said it’s ‘impossible’ to spend time with all his kids (Picture: Andrew Harnik/Getty Images)

Exa got the nickname Y, as XAE A-XII had been given the nickname X.

More twins followed in November 2021, when Musk welcomed a boy and a girl, Strider and Azure, with Neuralink executive Shivon Zilis.

The same week the twins’ births were announced, things got extra complicated when it was revealed that Musk had a third child with Grimes – a boy named Techno Mechanicus, who has been nicknamed Tau.

Back to Zilis, Musk had his 12th child with her in February 2024. The baby girl is named Arcadia.

Lucky number 13 was son Romulus, born to Musk and conservative journalist Ashley St. Clair.

She wrote on X in February 2025: ‘Five months ago, I welcomed a new baby into the world. Elon Musk is the father.’

Finally, Zilis confirmed that she and Musk had a fourth child.

 

The CEO, pictured here with ex-wife Talulah Riley, has multiple twins and triplets (Picture: Daniel Acker/Bloomberg via Getty Images)

 

His son XAE A-XII has been given the nickname X (Picture: Theo Wargo/Getty Images for TIME)

His birthdate was not revealed, only adding to the baffling nature of the whole timeline, but we do know that he is called Seldon Lycurgus, and he’s Musk’s 14th kid.

## What have his children said about him?

The parent-child relationship to attract the most attention in the Musk clan is that between him and Vivian, who came out as transgender in 2022.

Having filed a request to take her mother’s surname, she changed her name in full to Vivian Jenna Wilson, stating: ‘I no longer live with or wish to be related to my biological father in any way, shape, or form.’

The 22-year-old model, who boasts one million Instagram followers, then received praise this week for how she responded to an interviewer in a now-viral red carpet moment.

Attending a 40th-anniversary event for Spanish brand Desigual, a reporter said to Vivian: ‘Your father’s the best, no?’

‘My, what? Sorry?’, she replied, her expression falling, to which the man repeated: ‘The best, your father.’

 

Daughter Vivian came out as trans in 2022 (Picture: Dominique Charriau/WireImage)

To view this video please enable JavaScript, and consider upgrading to a web browser that supports HTML5 video

Taken aback and clearly irritated, Vivian simply said, ‘OK’ and walked off.

Musk has been criticised for his anti-trans comments about Vivian, having deadnamed her publicly and saying she’s been ‘killed’ by the ‘woke mind virus’.

Asked in March last year if she ever feels ‘scared’ of Musk, the world’s richest man, she told Teen Vogue defiantly: ‘He’s a pathetic manchild. Why would I feel scared of him?

‘”Ohhh, he has so much power!” Nah, nah, nah. I don’t give a f**k. Why should I be scared of this man? Because he’s rich? Oh, no, I’m trembling. Ooh, shivering in my boots here. I don’t give a f**k how much money anyone has. I don’t. I really don’t. He owns Twitter. OK. Congratulations.’

## Elon Musk's children in order of birth 

- Nevada Alexander Musk (born 2002, died aged 10 weeks)
- Griffin and Vivian Musk (born April 2004)
- Kai, Saxon, and Damian Musk (born 2006)
- X AE A-XII Musk (born May 2020)
- Strider and Azure Musk (born November 2021)
- Exa Dark Sideræl Musk (born December 2021)
- Techno Mechanicus (birthdate unknown)
- Arcadia (born February 2024)
- Romulus (born September 2024)
- Seldon Lycurgus (birthdate unknown)

‘People thrive off of fear. I’m not giving anyone that space in my mind,’ she stated proudly. ‘The only thing that gets to live free in my mind are drag queens.’

When it comes to the rest of Musk’s children, he’s said it’s ‘impossible’ to spend time with all of them.

Speaking on the WTF Is podcast hosted by Nikhil Kamath, Musk quipped that he already has an ‘army’ of kids.

 

She changed her name in full to Vivian Jenna Wilson, stating she wants ‘no relation’ to her biological father (Picture: Phillip Faraone/Getty Images for Teen Vogue)

‘I have some older kids that are adults, essentially, then a bunch of younger kids.

‘I definitely have my hands full right now. I do want to be able to spend some time with my kids. Right before coming here, I was with my kids, seeing them before bedtime, that kind of thing.’

‘Beyond a certain number, it’s like, kind of impossible to spend time with them,’ he added.

He said his older children are ‘very independent’, so he sees his sons ‘once in a while’.

‘I can only have enough kids on the young side where it’s humanly possible to spend time with them.’

Despite this, he remains ‘worried about the population decline’ and is ‘not opposed’ to welcoming more via adoption.

## Who are Elon Musk’s parents?

 

Musk has remained close with his mother, Maye (Picture: Angela Weiss/AFP via Getty Images)

 

In contrast, he has described his estranged father, Errol, as emotionally abusive (Picture: Alexander Zemlianichenko/Pool/AFP via Getty Images)

Given the chaos of fathering 14 children, it will come as no shock to learn that Musk has a complex past with his own parents.

The businessman, who is of British and Pennsylvania Dutch ancestry, was born in Pretoria, South Africa’s capital, to mother Maye and father Errol.

Maye, 78, is a model and dietitian born in Saskatchewan, Canada, but raised in South Africa, meaning Musk has held both South African and Canadian citizenship since birth.

Errol, 80, the patriarch of the Musk family, is a successful South African businessman and politician.

## Is Elon Musk the richest man in the world? 

After Tesla’s stock began to pop in 2013, Musk’s wealth has been on the incline, and he surpassed Amazon founder Jeff Bezos as the world’s wealthiest person in 2021.

The SpaceX CEO is now poised to sail past the $1trillion mark, with his current net worth sitting at well over $800billion.

While he has remained close with his mother long into adulthood, Musk distanced himself from his father when he moved to Canada for university aged 17. He has described his father as emotionally abusive.

In 2023, The New York Times published an investigation in which Errol was accused of sexually abusing five of his children and stepchildren in California and South Africa from 1993, leading to three separate police investigations.

Errol said the reports are ‘false and nonsense in the extreme’, saying relatives were ‘putting the children up to say false things’ for money.

 

The almost-trillionaire had a public romance with singer Grimes from 2018 (Picture: Angela Weiss/AFP via Getty Images)
